record.title: Model bounded identity and ordinary option-status SCPI exchanges
record.intent: Recover semantic observations from exact preserved read-only query transcripts.
requirements: Create a typed workspace library with explicit query alternatives for identity and the existing ordinary option-status selectors; do not accept arbitrary or mutating commands.
Preserve exact request and reply bytes, model identity strings without inferring firmware suffixes, and distinguish enabled disabled and malformed or unknown replies.
Decode bounded canonical exchanges with explicit framing and count checks; never normalize malformed data into an observation.
Provide a delegated offline CLI with private identity redaction by default and compare preserved query transcripts without any physical contact.
acceptance: Synthetic grammar controls and exact private transcript comparison pass under strict quality gates.
